what: The exact engine for the Fauzan/Calegari Hankel-determinant irrationality functional (hankel.py, hankel2.py), its quadrature checks (test2.py), the family scans and their drivers (scan.py, scan2.py, families_struct.py, family.py), the p-adic accounting (padic.py), the readers (traj.py, traj2.py, summary.py, show.py), the claimant notes, and every run record (runs/: 323 family files, 4,902 records, the K = 12n trajectories for k = 5 and 7, the v_p profiles) — ported from frontier-apps/experiments/zeta-hankel on 2026-10-05.
rule: Copied byte-for-byte and pinned by sha256, verified after the copy; frontier-apps has no git, so the hash is the only pin, and the source tree is read-only from this side. No file is patched: the engine runs unmodified from instruments/zetahankel/ (its modules import each other by name, so scripts run with that directory on sys.path). NOTES.md is kept as claimant-notes.md — it is the bench's account, read here as a claim. Records copied; everything with proof force per instance was RE-RUN here by instruments/zetahankel/rerun.py into certs/zeta-hankel-ledger.json (the four headline families at every h, Calegari's K = 12n family to h = 99, the p-adic profiles), test2.py was re-run here (certs/zeta-hankel/test2-certmachine.log), and crosscheck.py recomputes six small instances by a route that shares no code. The ~300-family scan itself was not re-run; it enters the ledger as lifted records under a reading marked extrapolation.
notPorted: .venv (a symlink to ../erdos1/.venv; the venv here is instruments/zetahankel/.venv, python-flint 0.9.0 + mpmath 1.4.1, the versions the bench ran); __pycache__; build-page.js and the bench page site/zeta-hankel/ (the page is tools/build-report-zeta-hankel.js in this design system, built from the ledger); the copies under site/zeta-hankel/data/ (byte-identical to NOTES.md, hankel.py, hankel2.py, test2.py lifted here).
